description: Exact machine-readable CSV from DEFRA's published UK Farm Animal Genetic Resources annual breed inventory. It is a breeding-structure benchmark only, not a fertility, semen or RF-exposure panel.
retrieval_method: Direct HTTPS download of the 2025 inventory-data CSV linked from the stable DEFRA FAnGR statistics landing page.

files.note: 38,458 source rows across seven livestock species and 204 breeds. The values are national annual breed-population structure variables, not individual fertility, semen quality or RF exposure.
